Our approach This short stay brings medical examinations and selected diagnostics together in a focused programme. It gives you time to look at your current health with professional guidance. The consultations, laboratory analyses and measurements listed below form the basis of your assessment. Your medical team discusses the findings with you during your stay. Your programme Begin with an assessment. The medical consultation places your health history and current questions at the centre of the programme. Gain a clearer picture. Selected laboratory analyses and diagnostic measurements add detail to the medical assessment. Discuss your findings. Medical conversations bring the results together and provide space for questions about your health. Your short stay. The retreat spans five days with four overnight stays. Therapies are scheduled after booking. Individual preferences and additional diagnostics can therefore only be accommodated to a limited extent. Programme additions require agreement with medical planning and are subject to availability.
